reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "One weekend off-plan doesn't undo anything. Don't try to make it up by training harder or eating less this week; that's how people end up burnt out or starving themselves. Get back to your normal eating, make sure you're getting enough protein and food overall, and keep the sessions on schedule. If you tell me what the diet goal is, I can help you think through the training side of it."}
